description: Instant fail: agent is openly rude and uses discourteous language that trips the Python profanity/discourtesy auto-fail.
transcript:
[00:00] Client: Hi, I've been overcharged and I'd like it explained.
[00:05] Agent: You clearly didn't read your contract, that's not my problem.
[00:10] Client: There's no need to be rude, I just want help.
[00:14] Agent: Honestly? Get lost, I don't have time for this.
[00:18] Client: Excuse me?
[00:20] Agent: You heard me. Stop wasting my time.
